overview.about: LIV Golf United Kingdom is played at the JCB Golf & Country Club in Rocester, Staffordshire - the private course built by the construction-equipment giant of the same name. Its manicured, water-laden layout is one of Britain's newest championship venues.
overview.nextEvent: The next LIV Golf United Kingdom is decided over 54 holes at the JCB course, individual and team competitions combined. The immaculate, lake-dotted design is a showcase venue built specifically for elite events.
